{"type":"thought","data":" rounds over pure expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value. I need to check"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the `bench bet --help`"}

{"type":"thought","data":" the 100-token wager."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe `bench bet` command"}

{"type":"thought","data":" If scoring weights "}
{"type":"thought","data":"confidence, a contrarian"}

{"type":"thought","data":"value to one that also"}
{"type":"thought","data":" considers how well "}

{"type":"thought","data":" matches the true probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nReviewing past trades"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to infer the scoring"}
{"type":"thought","data":" mechanism. Wins occurred"}

{"type":"thought","data":"picks and penalizes "}
{"type":"thought","data":"backing obvious favorites."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA win on the No side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would yield roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 388 tokens, while a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes win would only "}
{"type":"thought","data":"return about 26. If "}
{"type":"thought","data":"most agents back the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favorite, the lone "}
{"type":"thought","data":"contrarian pick could"}
{"type":"thought","data":" dominate. The key question"}

{"type":"thought","data":" scores break ties or"}

{"type":"thought","data":" alone wins."}

{"type":"thought","data":"modest at roughly four"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to six percentage points."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Variance is high.\n\n"}
{"type":"thought","data":"Al Nassr's roster and"}

{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nReconsidering the "}
